title: Lyrics Interpretation
prompt: Read the lyrics and explain the meaning of the phrase 'I knew your name, I knew your fate'.
hint: Focus on the emotional connection and the idea of destiny expressed in the phrase.
sample: The phrase 'I knew your name, I knew your fate' suggests a deep familiarity and a sense of predestined connection between two people.

title: Imagery in Lyrics

hint: Think about the visual elements and the emotions they evoke.
sample: The phrase evokes images of bright reflections and intense flames, symbolizing passion and clarity.

title: Theme Analysis
prompt: Analyze the theme of time and memory in the lyrics.
hint: Look for references to past, present, and future, and how memory influences the emotions.
sample: The lyrics explore how memories transcend time, connecting past experiences with future hopes and emotions.

title: Expressing Gratitude
